name: IMDb Air Date Fixer
description: Sets 'Date added' to the air/release date so Recently Added is ordered by release instead of file creation time. Episodes missing an air date or title are looked up via the series' IMDb/TVDb ID on TVmaze (and optionally OMDb/IMDb data). If nothing is found, the date is estimated from the series' other episodes, and items with no date at all get January 1st of their own or the series' start year so they never show up first. Original dates are backed up and can be restored.
overview: Recently Added ordered by air date, plus missing air dates and titles via IMDb IDs

versions.changelog: 1.2.0: Renamed to IMDb Air Date Fixer. Everything is now in English. Items without any air date get January 1st of their own year or the series' start year (fallback 2000) instead of showing up first.
